section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种基因工程生物培养箱，涉及培养箱领域，包括箱体，所述箱体的内壁设置有加热器，且箱体的顶端设置有贯穿至箱体内壁的通气孔，所述箱体的内壁位于通气孔的一侧设置有湿度传感器，且箱体的内壁位于湿度传感器的一侧设置有白炽灯，所述箱体的内壁位于白炽灯的一侧设置有紫外线杀菌灯。本实用新型通过设置电动推杆、一号连接板、二号连接板、固定块，当需对该装置装车进行搬运移动时，可启动电动推杆，电动推杆推动一号连接板进行移动，一号连接板推动二号连接板从而将支撑板推至水平状态，增加箱体与搬运车之间的接触面积，从而解决无法在搬运移动过程中增加箱体的稳定性的问题。

The utility model discloses a genetic engineering biological incubator relates to the incubator field, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the inner wall of box is provided with the heater, and the top of box is provided with the air vent that runs through to the box inner wall, one side that the inner wall of box is located the air vent is provided with humidity transducer, and one side that the inner wall of box is located humidity transducer is provided with the incandescent lamp, one side that the inner wall of box is located the incandescent lamp is provided with sterilamp. The utility model discloses a set up electric putter, connecting plate, No. two connecting plates, fixed block, when needing to carry the removal to the device loading, can start electric putter, electric putter promotes a connecting plate and removes, thereby a connecting plate promotes No. two connecting plates and pushes away the backup pad to the horizontality, increases the area of contact between box and the carrier to the problem of the stability that can't increase the box in the transport removal process is solved.

Biological incubator of genetic engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to an incubator field specifically is a genetic engineering biological incubator.

Background

The biological incubator has the temperature controllable function of a refrigeration and heating bidirectional temperature regulation system, is one of indispensable laboratory equipment of plant, organism, microorganism, heredity, virus, environmental protection and other scientific research and teaching departments, and is widely applied to constant temperature tests, culture tests, environmental experiments and the like.

However, a general biological incubator cannot wipe the observation window in the experiment process, so that water drops generated when the environment inside the incubator is adjusted can cover the observation window, thereby affecting the observation of internal organisms by experimenters; the stability of box can't be increased at the transport removal in-process, the rocking that produces at the transport removal in-process can lead to the box to empty to cause unnecessary damage to the box.

Disclosure of Invention

The utility model aims to provide a: in order to solve the problem that the observation window cannot be wiped in the experimental process and the stability of the box cannot be increased in the carrying and moving process, a genetic engineering biological incubator is provided.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a gene engineering biological incubator comprises a box body, wherein a heater is arranged on the inner wall of the box body, an air vent penetrating through the box body to the inner wall of the box body is formed in the top end of the box body, a humidity sensor is arranged on one side, located at the air vent, of the inner wall of the box body, an incandescent lamp is arranged on one side, located at the humidity sensor, of the inner wall of the box body, an ultraviolet germicidal lamp is arranged on one side, located at the incandescent lamp, of the inner wall of the box body, a temperature sensor is arranged on one side, located at the ultraviolet germicidal lamp, of the inner wall of the box body, a first sliding groove is formed in the lower portion of the heater, a placing plate is arranged in the box body, a first pulley is arranged in the first sliding groove on two sides of the placing plate, an electric push rod is arranged in the box body, the first connecting plate is connected to the output end of, the both sides of box are provided with the backup pad, and the top of backup pad is provided with the fixed block, the inside of box is provided with the humidifier, and the one end of box is connected with the sealing door through hinge rotation, one side of sealing door is provided with the observation window that runs through to the opposite side, and the both ends of observation window are provided with cleans the piece, it is provided with and cleans the pad to clean one side of piece, and cleans the inside that the top of piece is located the sealing door and is provided with the movable block that runs through to the sealing door outside, the inside of sealing door is provided with the spout No. two, the inside that the both sides of movable block are located the spout No..

Preferably, the inner wall of the box body is provided with an insulating layer.

Preferably, No. two connecting plates pass through the fixed block with the backup pad and rotate and be connected, a connecting plate rotates through the pivot with No. two connecting plates and is connected, the backup pad rotates through the pivot with the box and is connected.

Preferably, the part of the sealing door, which is in contact with the box body, is provided with a sealing gasket, and the joint of the sealing door and the wiping block is provided with the sealing gasket.

Preferably, the wiping pad is made of soft sponge, and the wiping pad is attached to two ends of the observation window.

Preferably, grooves larger than the second connecting plate are formed in two sides of the box body, and the second connecting plate penetrates through the grooves to reach the outer side of the box body.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the utility model discloses a set up electric putter, connecting plate two, fixed block, when needing to carry the removal to the device loading, can start electric putter, electric putter promotes connecting plate one and moves, and connecting plate one promotes connecting plate two so as to push the backup pad to the horizontality, increases the area of contact between box and the carrier, thereby solves the problem that can't increase the stability of box in the transport removal process; the movable block can be pushed by arranging the wiping block, the wiping pad and the movable block, and the second pulleys on two sides of the movable block slide in the second sliding groove, so that the wiping pad can wipe two ends of the observation window, and the problem that the observation window cannot be wiped in the experimental process is solved.

In the figure: 1. a box body; 2. a heater; 3. a temperature sensor; 4. an ultraviolet germicidal lamp; 5. an incandescent lamp; 6. a vent hole; 7. an observation window; 8. a wiping block; 9. a sealing door; 10. a first chute; 11. a first pulley; 12. placing the plate; 13. a humidity sensor; 14. an electric push rod; 15. a first connecting plate; 16. a second connecting plate; 17. a support plate; 18. a fixed block; 19. a moving block; 20. a second chute; 21. a second pulley; 22. a wiping pad; 23. a humidifier.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

The electric push rod (model: GRA-L50) mentioned in the utility model can be obtained by market or private ordering.

Referring to fig. 1-4, a genetic engineering biological incubator comprises a box body 1, a heater 2 is disposed on the inner wall of the box body 1, a vent hole 6 penetrating through the inner wall of the box body 1 is disposed at the top end of the box body 1, a humidity sensor 13 is disposed on one side of the vent hole 6 on the inner wall of the box body 1, an incandescent lamp 5 is disposed on one side of the humidity sensor 13 on the inner wall of the box body 1, an ultraviolet germicidal lamp 4 is disposed on one side of the incandescent lamp 5 on the inner wall of the box body 1, a temperature sensor 3 is disposed on one side of the ultraviolet germicidal lamp 4 on the inner wall of the box body 1, a first sliding groove 10 is disposed on the inner wall of the box body 1 below the heater 2, a placing plate 12 is disposed inside the box body 1, a first pulley 11 is disposed on the inner side of the first sliding groove 10 on both sides of the placing plate 12, and the output of electric putter 14 is connected with connecting plate 15 No. one, one side of connecting plate 15 is provided with and runs through No. two connecting plates 16 to the box 1 outside, the both sides of box 1 are provided with backup pad 17, and the top of backup pad 17 is provided with fixed block 18, the inside of box 1 is provided with humidifier 23, and the one end of box 1 is connected with sealing door 9 through hinge rotation, one side of sealing door 9 is provided with and runs through observation window 7 to the opposite side, and the both ends of observation window 7 are provided with wipes piece 8, one side of wiping piece 8 is provided with wipes pad 22, and the inside that the top of wiping piece 8 is located sealing door 9 is provided with and runs through No. two pulleys 21 to the sealing door 9 outside, the inside of sealing door 9 is provided with No. two spout 20, the inside that the both sides of moving piece 19 are located no.

Referring to fig. 1, the inner wall of the case 1 is provided with an insulating layer for preventing the temperature inside the case 1 from being lost.

Please refer to fig. 1, the second connecting plate 16 is rotatably connected to the supporting plate 17 through the fixing block 18, the first connecting plate 15 is rotatably connected to the second connecting plate 16 through the rotating shaft, and the supporting plate 17 is rotatably connected to the box body 1 through the rotating shaft, so that the supporting plate 17 can rotate when the electric push rod 14 pushes the first connecting plate 15.

Please refer to fig. 1 and 4, a sealing gasket is disposed at a portion of the sealing door 9 contacting the box 1, and a sealing gasket is disposed at a joint of the sealing door 9 and the wiping block 8 to prevent the external environment from interfering with the internal environment of the box 1.

Please refer to fig. 4, the wiping pad 22 is made of soft sponge, and the wiping pad 22 is attached to two ends of the observation window 7 for wiping the observation window 7.

Please refer to fig. 1 and 2, two sides of the box 1 are provided with a groove larger than the second connecting plate 16, and the second connecting plate 16 passes through the groove to reach the outer side of the box 1, so that the second connecting plate 16 pushes the supporting plate 17, thereby rotating the supporting plate 17.

The working principle is as follows: when the device is used by a user, a living being required to be observed can be placed into the box body 1 to be moved on the top of the placing plate 12, the sealing door 9 is closed, the environment in the box body 1 can be adjusted and observed through the temperature sensor 3, the heater 2, the humidity sensor 13 and the humidifier 23, the current situation of the living being can be observed through the observation window 7, when the inner surface of the observation window 7 forms water drops due to the change of the environment in the box body 1, the moving block 19 can be pushed, the second pulleys 21 on the two sides of the moving block 19 slide in the second sliding grooves 20, the wiping pads 22 wipe the two ends of the observation window 7, so that the observation window 7 is cleaned, when the device is required to be loaded to be transported and moved, the electric push rod 14 can be started, the first connecting plate 15 is pushed, the second connecting plate 16 is pushed by the first connecting plate 15, so that the supporting plate 17 is pushed to be in a horizontal state, increase the area of contact between box 1 and the carrier to increase the stability of box 1, prevent that box 1 from toppling over to both sides because of rocking, can contract electric putter 14 after the transport, make backup pad 17 and box 1's both sides laminating, thereby reach the effect of packing up backup pad 17, still can will place board 12 and take out box 1 through a pulley 11 after the experiment, thereby wash it, so that use next time.

It is obvious to a person skilled in the art that the invention is not restricted to details of the above-described exemplary embodiments, but that it can be implemented in other specific forms without departing from the spirit or essential characteristics of the invention.
